subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets (line, bar, area, sparkline, gauge)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor line/bar/area/sparkline/gauge as first-party dashboard builtins after the Wave 1 dashboard surface lands, or keep charting as custom/external widgets first?
rationale: The request is useful and fits web-frontend ergonomics, but it depends on unmerged dashboard infrastructure and a maintainer choice about bundled builtin scope versus external/plugin distribution.

options.title: Sponsor Bounded Builtins
options.body: Keep this as the chart-widget leaf item and implement it only after the dashboard schema and renderer surface are accepted.

options.title: Prove As External Widgets First
options.body: Ask charting to ship first through custom widgets or a ClawHub/plugin package before promoting it to bundled builtins.

options.title: Defer With The Roadmap
options.body: Keep the item open but pause implementation until the broader modular-dashboard roadmap is accepted, narrowed, or rejected.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Bounded Builtins
recommendation.body: Keep this as the chart-widget leaf item and implement it only after the dashboard schema and renderer surface are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and merged the precedent this dashboard work builds on.
